answer: Physical Substrate Attestation. Each agent identity embeds a sensor fingerprint bound to a tamper-evident chip fused to a basalt-ceramic package whose microcracks form a unique per-unit signature. Registration requires periodic fresh readings; cloning yields no valid signature. A velvet-sealed calibration record binds chip, package, and operator. Attackers must physically acquire and fuse one package per identity, and a plume of failed challenges exposes fakes. Cost: one fabricated chip per sybil.
